segments.he: הלכה ג
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the Shabbos boundary — techum Shabbos — of two thousand amos, which is the aspect of two Alephs. For Shabbos is the aspect of teshuvah, through which is formed the aspect of the Aleph mentioned above, which is the aspect of Adam etc. And all this is accomplished through the aspect of Ehyeh — the aspect of ana zamin l'mihavei [I am destined to become] — and there is no Ehyeh without an Aleph, the aspect of the Aleph mentioned above. And one must do teshuvah upon teshuvah, and one must also be expert in halachah — expert in ratzo, expert in shov, expert in entering, expert in exiting — in the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven, there You are; and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You are there" — which is the aspect of the secret of the kavanos of Elul, through which one merits to walk in the ways of teshuvah. And this itself is the aspect of teshuvah upon teshuvah, as is brought in our words elsewhere.

segments.he: אות א

על פי המאמר תקעו בחודששופר המתחיל מאמונה (בלקוטיתנינא סימן ה') עיין שם כלהמאמר. והכלל כשמתקנין פגם האמונה אזי נעשין מזה גרים והגרים מכניסין גאוה בישראל ועל ידי הגאוה נעשה פגם ניאוף ח"ו. והמגינים שבדור מעלין פגם תאוות ניאוף ונעשה מזה בחנית מוחין תפילין בחינת חותם דקדושה. ואזי הוא בחינת חלם על ידי מלאך שהוא בחינת אדם ולא חלום על ידי שד חץו שהוא בחינת בהמה. אבל יש להמאכלים חלק בחלום. לזה צריכין שמחה שהוא חיזוק המלאך ועיקר חיזור המלאך הוא בניסן. ואז היה ראוי שיתבטל פגם טומאה זו. אבל יש שבא על ידי קלקול המשפט וקלקול המשפט נעשה על ידי שמעלין טיפת עשו וישמעאל. ואזי על ידי קלקול כסאות למשפט נופלין אהבות מן המרכבה וכו'. ולזה צריכין קישור המרכבה בחינת מרכבו ארגמן וכו' (עיין שם כל המאמר היטב):
segments.en: For it is impossible to merit the aforementioned expertise except for one who is strong within himself to walk in the ways of teshuvah constantly, however things may be etc. And all this is impossible to merit except through the power of the Tzadik, who does teshuvah upon teshuvah constantly etc., as mentioned above. And all this is the aspect of Shabbos, as mentioned above. Therefore, techum Shabbos is two thousand amos — the aspect of two Alephs mentioned above. For teshuvah is the aspect of Aleph, the aspect of Ehyeh, but one needs teshuvah upon teshuvah, and one also needs the two expertises mentioned above — the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven" etc. "and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You" etc. Therefore they are two Alephs, for each teshuvah is the aspect of an Aleph, the aspect of Ehyeh — ana zamin l'mihavei etc. For on Shabbos it is said (Shemos 16): "Let every man remain in his place; let no man go out from his place" — for it is a day of rest and repose in which there is no upheaval of travel. For all the journeys and upheavals of the six weekdays are for the sake of berurim — to refine the holy sparks from amidst the kelipos that were scattered to the four corners of the earth through the sin of Adam HaRishon and through the sins of all the generations. For this reason one must travel the roads to refine them. And this itself is the aspect of what Rabeinu z"l said (in siman 40 and in Part II, siman 62) — that all journeys are for the purpose of rectifying the damage to emunah that is damaged through sins. For "all Your commandments are emunah" (Tehillim 119), and according to the damage one inflicts through some transgression or neglect of a mitzvah, so is the emunah damaged, chas v'shalom. Therefore one must return in teshuvah to rectify the damage of the sin, which is the damage to the holy emunah — and for this come the upheavals of travel, as mentioned above. And one who merits to travel or journey on the road as befits a Jewish person — who remembers Hashem always, in the aspect of "when you sit in your house and when you walk on the way" (Devarim 6), and especially on the road where one must be extra careful to remember Hashem, for "all roads are presumed dangerous" — and the essential danger is that through the upheaval of travel one may forget Hashem, from which stem all dangers even physically — and one who merits to travel on the road as befits a Jew, then the road is in the aspect of "The way of emunah I have chosen" (Tehillim 119), the aspect of ways of teshuvah. But the essential rectification of the road, the rectification of emunah, the rectification of the ways of teshuvah, is on Shabbos — for then there is no birur; rather, all the berurim of all the weekdays return to their place on Shabbos and come to their resting place, in the aspect of "repose of tranquility, quietude, and security" etc. And therefore, on Shabbos it is forbidden even to take a large stride, for then is the essential rectification of teshuvah, which is the aspect of Shabbos, which is the aspect of "they say to him: Wait!" — for it is impossible to take a large stride. For the completeness of teshuvah, the aspect of Shabbos, is in the aspect of deliberateness — the aspect of the aforementioned "Wait!" And therefore it is forbidden on Shabbos to walk on distant roads, only two thousand amos for a stroll — which is the aspect of techum Shabbos. For all the walking of Shabbos is only in the aspect of ways of teshuvah that are completed on Shabbos and come to their rest. Therefore they are two thousand amos — the aspect of the two Alephs mentioned above, which are the aspect of the ways of teshuvah, as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of "L'chah dodi neitzei ha'sadeh, nalinah ba'k'farim, nashkimah la'kramim" — "Come, my beloved, let us go out to the field; let us lodge in the villages; let us arise early to the vineyards" (Shir HaShirim 7). "Let us lodge in the villages [k'farim]" — and our Sages of blessed memory expounded (Eiruvin 21b): "among the kof'rim" — those who are the wicked, who have distanced themselves greatly from Hashem, for they too must be returned in teshuvah. This is the aspect of "and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You are there" — to subdue and nullify their evil, which is the aspect of cutting off the seed of Amalek — the aspect of subduing the utter evil of the blood in the chalal has'mali and refining the good from them, to return them in teshuvah. "Let us arise early to the vineyards [kramim]" — these are the aspect of the upright and righteous, who are called kramim, as it is written (Hoshea 2): "And I shall give her her vineyards" etc., from there — as our Sages of blessed memory expounded (Rashi; see Yalkut Hoshea). And likewise (Iyov 24): "He does not turn to the way of the vineyards" — as Rashi explains there. For even the righteous must be in a state of constant teshuvah, as mentioned above — which is the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven, there You are." And all this is said in Shir HaShirim regarding the holiness of Shabbos, as is brought in the Ksavim [writings of the Arizal] — for then the essential road, to go out to the field, is only for the sake of the aspect of the ways of teshuvah that are completed then, in the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven, there You are; and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You are there" — which is the aspect of "let us lodge among the villages, let us arise early to the vineyards" etc., as mentioned above. And this is: "There I will give you my love" — for this is the essential completeness of the bond and the love between Knesses Yisrael and Hashem: when the ways of teshuvah are completed as mentioned above. And this is: "The dudaim have given forth fragrance" — the two types of dudaim, the good and the bad, as Rashi explains there — that is, as mentioned above.

segments.he: והנה המן הרשע שהוא מזרע עמלק שהוא ממונה על פגם טומאה זו רצה להתגבר על ישראל בזמן גלות בבל שבעים שנה שהוא בחינת שינה (כמובא בספרים). והתגברותו על ישראל היה על ידי פגם המאכלים כמו שאמרו רז"ל מפני מה נתחייבו שונאיהן של ישראל שבאותו הדור כליה מפני שנהנו מסעודתו של אותו רשע. כי מאכלים טמאים הם בחינת פגם אכילת עץ הדעת טוב ורע שפגם בו אדם הראשון שעל ידי זה פגם בטיפי המוח. ועל ידי זה נתקלל בעצבון תאכלנה. ועל כן עיקר התיקון על ידי השמחה היפך בעצבון תאכלנה. אבל אין יכולין לתקן כי אם מאכלים טהורים שתיקונם כשזוכין לאכול בשמחה כמבואר שם. אבל מאכלים טמאים שאסרה תורה אין להם שום תיקון. ועל כן מי שנהנה מהם נמשך עליו ח"ו בחינת בעצבון הנ"ל שהוא פגם חטא אדם הראשון שמשם נמשך ח"ו טומאה הנ"ל שממונה עליו המן עמלק. שעל ידי זה נתחיבו שונאיהן של ישראל כליה ח"ו. כל על פגם זה נאמר ביום אכלך ממנו מות תמות וזה שאמרור זל עוד מפני שהשתחוו לצלם וכו' והיינו הך ולא פליגי כי הא בהא תליא. כי השתחוו לעבודה זרה היינו פגם אמונה שהיא התחלת הפגם. ואחר כך נמשך מזה הפגפ אמונה פגם טומאה הנל (כמבואר שם במאמר הנ"ל עיין שם) וגם על אדם הראשון אמרו רז"ל שפגם באמונה כמו שאמרו רז"ל שכפר בעיקר. כי כל הבחינות הנ"ל קשורים זה בזה. פגם אמונה ופגם טומאה הנ"ל ופגם המאכלים ח"ו (כמבואר שם עיין שם היטב). כי אחיזתהמן היה מפגם עץ הדעת כמו שאמרו רז"ל המן מן התשובה מנין שנאמר המן העץ וכו' היינו כנ"ל. ועל כן רצה להתגבר בחדש אר שמת בו משה כי מיתת משה זה בחינת הסתלקות הדעת בחינת שינה. שאז הוא זמן התגברותו ח"ו כשאין תיקון בכל הבחינות הנ"ל:
segments.en: And for this reason, people travel to the Tzadikim for Shabbos. For every Tzadik is in the aspect of Moshe, as is written elsewhere. And the essential secret of the holiness of Shabbos — Hashem made it known to Moshe, that he should go and inform Yisrael, in the aspect of "go and inform them," as mentioned above. And so in every generation, one must come to the true Tzadik, who will inform him of the holiness of Shabbos, which is the aspect of teshuvah. For certainly the essential reason people travel to the true Tzadikim is in order to merit teshuvah from wherever one may be. For one who travels and comes to the Rav for some other agenda — to receive from him some rabbinical appointment or other position etc. — this is not included in the category of drawing close to the Tzadik at all, for he is traveling for his own honor. But the essential drawing close to the Tzadik is when one's intention is for Hashem alone — that the Tzadik should draw him close to Hashem and bring him back from the place where he has fallen etc. And therefore, most people travel for Shabbos, for the essential way of teshuvah — which is the aspect of expertise in halachah etc., the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven, there You are; and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You are there" — is through the holiness of Shabbos, as mentioned above. And therefore, all the preparation for the holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the Ten Days of Teshuvah, and Yom Kippur, is through the Shabbasos that precede them. As our Sages of blessed memory said (Orach Chaim 428) — they instituted that before Rosh HaShanah we read: the t'lasa d'fur'anusa [three of punishment] on the three Shabbasos of Bein HaMetzarim, and afterwards the shiv'ah d'nechemta [seven of consolation] and the tartei d'siyuvta [two of teshuvah]. For the essential holiness of Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur is to merit teshuvah, for they are the Ten Days of Teshuvah. And the essential teshuvah is through Shabbos, as mentioned above. For the essential unification between Moshe and Yehoshua — who are the aspects of the sun and the moon, the upper point and the lower point — is through the holiness of Shabbos, as mentioned above. For the essential rectification is that the aspect of Moshe etc. should illuminate the aspect of Yehoshua etc. Through this, the aspect of the Aleph is completed and Adam is formed to sit upon the Throne — and this is principally accomplished on Shabbos, in the aspect of "On the seventh day He was elevated and sat upon His Throne of glory" etc. For when a person sins, chas v'shalom, then according to his sin, the upper point withdraws and becomes concealed and does not illuminate the lower point. This is the aspect of separation — which is the essential damage of all sins, chas v'shalom. And through this, the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed — for it is the aspect of the upper point that has withdrawn upward and does not properly illuminate the lower point. For it is explained there in the aforementioned Torah that the Beis HaMikdash is the aspect of the upper point. Therefore, when sins prevailed and the upper point withdrew upward, the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed — the established place from which the upper point illuminated the lower point. And then it is the aspect of the departure of the Shechinah — the aspect of "ten journeys the Shechinah traveled" etc., as our Sages of blessed memory said (Rosh HaShanah 31a). And then all our vitality comes specifically from the concealment — from the ma'amar sasum [closed utterance] that gives life to all places distant from holiness etc., as is explained in the Torah "V'ayeh ha'seh l'olah" (Part II, siman 12). And then one must cry out "Eichah" — which is the aspect of "Ayeh" [Where?] (as is brought from this in our words, in Hilchos Yibum V'Chalitzah, Halachah 4). And this is the aspect of the three Shabbasos of Bein HaMetzarim, which begin from the seventeenth of Tamuz when the Luchos were broken on account of the Sin of the Golden Calf. For the breaking of the Luchos that Moshe broke when he saw the enormity of the destruction — that they had done such unseemly deeds, which is the making of the Calf, which is avodah zarah, which is "filth without a place" (Yeshayahu 28), and also "and they arose to make merry" etc. (Shemos 32), as our Sages of blessed memory expounded (Tanchuma Ki Sisa 20) and is brought in the commentary of Rashi — and then Moshe broke the Luchos and Hashem concurred with him, as our Sages of blessed memory said (Shabbos 87). For in this — that he broke the Luchos — he wrought a wondrous rectification. That is, he saw that now it was impossible in any manner to receive any holiness in a revealed manner, but only in a hidden manner — through the aspect of seeking and searching, which is the aspect of "Ayeh" mentioned above, which is the ma'amar sasum that gives life to all distant places, even those called "filthy places," as is written in the aforementioned Torah. And this is the aspect of the breaking of the Luchos — the letters flew upward, and the holiness ascended upward. These are the letters of the Torah, through which His glory is principally revealed in the Ten Utterances, which are the aspect of the Ten Commandments. And through this, he drew forth the aspect of the rectification of seeking "Ayeh" mentioned above — to show that now all rectification comes specifically through the concealment and the withdrawal. One who wishes to have compassion on himself, when he sees the enormity of the destruction, must search and seek: "Where is the place of His glory?" — for His glory has withdrawn and become exceedingly concealed etc. And for this reason they cry out "Eichah" at chatzos and on Tisha B'Av — the aspect of "Ayeh" mentioned above. And then, during Bein HaMetzarim, all the rectification is through the three Shabbasos of Bein HaMetzarim, on which we read the t'lasa d'fur'anusa to arouse Yisrael in teshuvah. And the essential teshuvah then is through the seeking of "Ayeh" mentioned above, which is the aspect of the cry of "Eichah," as mentioned above. And therefore they are three Shabbasos, corresponding to the three uppermost [sefiros], which are the aspect of the ma'amar sasum — the aspect of the upper point, which is the aspect of Kisei d'miskas'ya etc. — which is the aspect of the nekudas segol that comprises three points. For the three uppermost are considered as one and are all included in the aspect of Keser, the ma'amar sasum — for regarding them it is said (Chagigah 13): "Into what is too wondrous for you, do not inquire" — as is brought on the verse (Devarim 4): "And from one end of heaven to the other end of heaven you inquire" — which are the aspect of the seven days of creation etc. And the main point is: the essential rectification is when there is unification between the sun and the moon, between Moshe and Yehoshua — which are the aspects of the upper point and the lower point — which is when the seed of Amalek is subdued, which is the aspect of the intensity of the blood in the chalal has'mali etc. And then the upper point illuminates the lower point — Moshe illuminates Yehoshua through the aspect of the Vav within the Aleph. And then the Aleph is completed and Adam is formed to sit upon the Throne etc. And all this will not be in completeness until the Beis HaMikdash is built, which is the aspect of the upper point etc. But in the time of the churban, which is the aspect of Bein HaMetzarim, then the rectification is only through the cries of "Eichah" — the aspect of seeking "Ayeh" mentioned above. But even this is impossible to merit except through the holiness of Shabbos Kodesh — for then the aspect of "Ayeh" illuminates, and then one merits to ascend there in holiness. For then is the ascent of all the worlds to the ma'amar sasum. And with this power, one can draw the holiness of Shabbos into the six weekdays — to merit complete teshuvah, even those who have fallen very far, who are in the aspect of v'nafik — that they too can find Hashem through seeking and searching: "Where is the place of His glory?" (As is explained in all this in Hilchos Shabbos, Halachah 5; see there well.) And see in our words regarding the seeking of "Ayeh" mentioned above — that the main point is that even when a person sees in himself that he has distanced himself very, very far through his evil and wretched deeds, until he has fallen, chas v'shalom, to the aspect of "filthy places" — even then, he should never despair of himself in any way. Rather, he should seek and search and inquire even from there: "Where is the place of His glory?" And through this, the descent will become the ultimate ascent, as is explained in siman 12 mentioned above and in the places where we have discussed this; see there. And after Tisha B'Av we read the shiv'ah d'nechemta [seven of consolation]. For through the mourning of Klal Yisrael during the three weeks and on Tisha B'Av, through this is drawn the aspect of the building of the Beis HaMikdash. As our Sages of blessed memory said (Ta'anis 30b): "Whoever mourns over Yerushalayim merits and sees her joy" — as is brought in the sefarim that at the end of Tisha B'Av, the sprouting of the horn of Mashiach occurs. And then Hashem consoles us with all manner of consolations, which are the shiv'ah d'nechemta that we read from Shabbos Nachamu until Rosh HaShanah, in which begins the sweetening of the charon af [fierce anger] of the Sin of the Golden Calf, as is written elsewhere. And therefore they are seven consolations, corresponding to the aspect of the Vav within the Aleph that illuminates the lower point — which are in their totality seven — through drawing the light from the aspect of the sprouting of the horn of Mashiach. For then all the above is rectified — the upper point illuminates the lower point properly through the aspect of the Vav, which is the essential rectification, as mentioned above. And all this we read before Rosh HaShanah and the Ten Days of Teshuvah. For the essential holiness of Rosh HaShanah, the Ten Days of Teshuvah, and Yom Kippur, is through these Shabbasos on which we read these Haftaros — for the essential rectification is through Shabbos, as mentioned above. And therefore, we afterwards read the tartei d'siyuvta [two of teshuvah] — "two" specifically — the aspect of teshuvah upon teshuvah, which is the aspect of "Were Yisrael to keep two Shabbasos" specifically, as mentioned above (in section 8). And it is known that all the rectifications that Yisrael are engaged in on Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur — all are completed on Shemini Atzeres and Simchas Torah, for then is the essential completion of the rectification and the unification. And then we finish the Torah and begin it anew from Beraishis etc., and conclude with Shabbos — which is Parshas "Vay'chulu". For this is the essential completion of all the rectifications we have been engaged in from Elul and Rosh HaShanah etc. until now — all in order to draw and illuminate within us the holiness of Shabbos, which is the aspect of teshuvah, so that from now on all Yisrael will merit to begin fulfilling the Torah anew and to return in teshuvah, each one from wherever he may be. So that there will be drawn upon us the aspect of expertise in halachah mentioned above — the aspect of expert in entering, expert in exiting — the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven, there You are; and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You are there" etc. Through this, the Aleph is completed and Adam is formed to sit upon the Throne etc. All of this is drawn through the holiness of Shabbos — for then the aspect of Moshe illuminates Yehoshua.
segments.he_nikud: וְהִנֵּה הָמָן הָרָשָׁע, שֶׁהוּא מִזֶּרַע עֲמָלֵק, שֶׁהוּא מְמֻנֶּה עַל פְּגַם טֻמְאָה זוֹ רָצָה לְהִתְגַּבֵּר עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּזְמַן גָּלוּת בָּבֶל שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שֵׁנָה, (כַּמּוּבָא בִּסְפָרִים. וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּתוֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל הָיָה עַל-יְדֵי פְּגַם הַמַּאֲכָלִים, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, מִפְּנֵי מָה נִתְחַיְּבוּ שׂוֹנְאֵיהֶן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבְּאוֹתוֹ הַדּוֹר כְּלָיָה? מִפְּנֵי שֶׁנֶּהֱנוּ מִסְּעֻדָּתוֹ שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ רָשָׁע. כִּי מַאֲכָלִים טְמֵאִים הֵם בְּחִינַת פְּגַם אֲכִילַת עֵץ הַדַּעַת טוֹב וָרָע שֶׁפָּגַם בּוֹ אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן, שֶׁעַל-יְדֵי זֶה פָּגַם בְּטִפֵּי הַמֹּחַ. וְעַל-יְדֵי זֶה נִתְקַלֵּל "בְּעִצָּבוֹן תֹּאכֲלֶנָּה". וְעַל-כֵּן עִקַּר הַתִּקּוּן עַל-יְדֵי הַשִּמְחָה, הֵפֶךְ בְּעִצָּבוֹן תֹּאכֲלֶנָּה, אֲבָל אֵין יְכוֹלִין לְתַקֵּן כִּי אִם מַאֲכָלִים טְהוֹרִים שֶׁתִּקּוּנָם כְּשֶׁזּוֹכִין לֶאֱכֹל בְּשִׂמְחָה, כַּמְבֹאָר שָׁם. אֲבָל מַאֲכָלִים טְמֵאִים שֶׁאָסְרָה תּוֹרָה אֵין לָהֶם שׁוּם תִּקּוּן, וְעַל-כֵּן מִי שֶׁנֶּהֱנֶה מֵהֶם נִמְשָׁךְ עָלָיו חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, בְּחִינַת בְּעִצָּבוֹן הַנַּ"ל, שֶׁהֵם פְּגַם חֵטְא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִמְשָׁךְ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, טֻמְאָה הַנַּ"ל שֶׁמְּמֻנֶּה עָלָיו הָמָן-עֲמָלֵק, שֶׁעַל-יְדֵי זֶה נִתְחַיְּבוּ שׂוֹנְאֵיהֶן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּלָיָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כִּי עַל פְּגַם זֶה נֶאֱמַר, "בְּיוֹם אֲכָלְךָ מִמֶּנּוּ מוֹת תָּמוּת". וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה עוֹד, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהִשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ לַצֶּלֶם וְכוּ'. וְהַיְנוּ הַךְ וְלָא פְּלִיגֵי, כִּי הָא בְּהָא תַּלְיָא, כִּי הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה, הַיְנוּ פְּגַם אֱמוּנָה שֶׁהִיא הַתְחָלַת הַפְּגָם. וְאַחַר כָּךְ נִמְשָׁךְ מִזֶּה הַפְּגַם אֱמוּנָה, פְּגַם טֻמְאָה הַנַּ"ל, (כַּמְבֹאָר שָׁם בַּמַּאֲמָר הַנַּ"ל, עַיֵּן שָׁם). וְגַם עַל אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן אָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה שֶׁפָּגַם בָּאֱמוּנָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה שֶׁכָּפַר בָּעִקָּר, כִּי כָּל הַבְּחִינוֹת הַנַּ"ל קְשׁוּרִים זֶה בָּזֶה. פְּגַם אֱמוּנָה וּפְגַם טֻמְאָה הַנַּ"ל וּפְגַם הַמַּאֲכָלִים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, (כַּמְבֹאָר שָׁם, עַיֵּן שָׁם הֵיטֵב). כִּי אֲחִיזַת הָמָן הָיָה מִפְּגַם עֵץ הַדַּעַת, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, הָמָן מִן הַתּוֹרָה מִנַּיִן? שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, "הֲמִן הָעֵץ וְכוּ'". הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ"ל. וְעַל-כֵּן רָצָה לְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּחֹדֶשׁ אֲדָר שֶׁמֵּת בּוֹ מֹשֶׁה, כִּי מִיתַת מֹשֶׁה זֶ

segments.he: אות ב

גם עיק חיזוק המלאך הוא בניסן (כמו שכתוב שם). כי אז הוא זמן שנותנין התמנות לכל המלאכים. ואז נתחדש הרצון ואז הוא זמן שמחתם. וחשב המן להתגבר עליהם בחודש אדר שהוא רחוק מניסן בתכלית הריחוק. כי חשב שכל חודש שהוא רחוק יותר מניסן נחלש בו כח המלאך יותר ועל כן רצה להתגבר באדר דייקא שהוא בתכלית הריחוק מניסן. וזה שדקדק הכתוב הפיל פור מים ליום ומחודש לחודש שנים עשר הוא חודש אדר. לחדש שנים עשר דייקא. כי זה דיקיא היתה מחשבתו הרעה מאחר שהוא חדש השנים עשר מניסן שהוא בתכלית הריחקו ממנו מה שאין חדש אחר רחוק מניסן יורת מאדר שהוא החדש האחרון. על כן רצה להתגבר בו ח"ו כי חשב שבו כבר נחלש יותר חיזוק המלאך כי עיקר החיזור הוא בניסן כנ"ל. וזה שכתוב ישנו עם אחד ודרשו רז"ל ישנו עם אחד לשון שינה כי עיקר כוחו בזמן השינה כנ"ל:
segments.en: And in this they conclude the Torah: that Moshe died and departed, and "Yehoshua bin Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, for Moshe had laid his hands" etc. And they conclude: "And for all the mighty hand and all the great terror that Moshe wrought before the eyes of all Yisrael" — that he broke the Luchos before their eyes. For this was his greatest act of might, more than all the wonders he performed — as is understood from this verse according to the exposition of our Sages of blessed memory mentioned above, who expounded this verse regarding his breaking the Luchos. For certainly it is a wondrous and awesome act of might and an exceedingly awesome novelty. For through this he drew the aspect of the rectification of seeking "Ayeh" mentioned above — through which there is great hope even for all those who have fallen very far, the aspect of "filthy places," which are the aspects of exceedingly wretched thoughts of immorality and heresy and crooked thoughts of the heart against Hashem and difficulties etc. — which are the aspect of avodah zarah etc. And nevertheless, even for them there is hope if they wish, through the seeking of "Ayeh" mentioned above, which was drawn through the breaking of the Luchos, as mentioned above. And therefore, afterwards we begin Beraishis — which is the ma'amar sasum [closed utterance], the aspect of "Ayeh" mentioned above — and conclude with Shabbos. For the essential rectification is through the holiness of Shabbos, as mentioned above. (See regarding this matter above in section 23, and in Hilchos Nefilas Apayim, Halachah 6, section 7.) And therefore, Moshe departed on Shabbos, at the time of Minchah, at ra'ava d'ra'avin [the will of all wills]. For he drew the aforementioned rectification to all those who have fallen and are distant, as mentioned above. For he departed in awesome holiness to the aspect of "Ayeh" — for "no man knows his burial place" (Devarim 34:6) — for there is the ultimate knowing of not-knowing, which is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos (as is written in Likutay Tinyana, siman 83). And from there he draws illumination to the aspect of Yehoshua — so that Yehoshua can illuminate to all Yisrael this path: to strengthen and arouse and support all those who have fallen greatly, that they should never despair in any way. Rather, they too should search and seek His glory, in the aspect of "Where is the place of His glory?" — until they merit each time to find Him, that He will shine His countenance upon them and they will be able to pray etc., they too. As is known — all this — to one who has begun to enter these holy paths: that even though it seems to him that he has already distanced himself so much that it is impossible for him to pray at all etc. — nevertheless, when he strengthens himself and asks and seeks "Ayeh" etc., as mentioned above, in the meantime Hashem helps him so that he too can pray somewhat. And if he is strong in this all his days, his end will be good forever. And all this is the aspect of the expertise in halachah mentioned above, which is drawn through the true Tzadik — the aspect of Moshe — who makes known and draws the holiness of Shabbos, which is the aspect of teshuvah upon teshuvah always, however one may be, on every level — in ascent and in descent — until all Yisrael return to Hashem. Through this will come the complete redemption speedily in our days, amen selah. And therefore, on Simchas Torah we immediately read the Haftarah from Yehoshua (Yehoshua 1): "Moshe My servant has died — now arise" etc. (See below, section 39.) And this is (Shemos 17): "For a hand is on the Throne of Y-ah — a war for Hashem with Amalek from generation to generation" — that "His Throne is not complete and His Name is not complete until the remembrance of Amalek is erased" (Tanchuma Ki Seitzei). For the main thing is to cut off the seed of Amalek, and this is accomplished through the aspect of Yehoshua specifically — in the aspect of "Go out and fight with Amalek" — which is the aspect of the lower point. But it is impossible for Yehoshua to accomplish anything except through the power of Moshe, the aspect of the upper point, as it is written: "And it was, when Moshe raised his hand" etc. And throughout the exile, Hashem fights with him, and then the Throne is not complete — the Aleph is lacking — and the Name is not complete. For when the aspect of Adam is formed to sit upon the Throne — this is the completeness of the Name Havayah, which is Havayah spelled with Alephs, equaling Mah [45] in gematria — equaling Adam. When the blood draws sustenance — when the Aleph in the middle of the Vav of the Name Mah withdraws, chas v'shalom — then it rises to Dam [blood], the aspect of the reverse of Ehyeh equaling Dam, as is explained in the writings of the Arizal in many places. And in every generation, to the degree that each person exerts himself to draw close to the true Tzadik amidst insults and much spilling of blood — so does the aspect of Moshe illuminate Yehoshua, the aspect of Rav and talmid, as mentioned above. Through this they cut off the seed of Amalek and all the rectifications are accomplished. But the war is very, very long. For Amalek has from of old been a "strap of chastisement for Yisrael" (Tanchuma Chukas) and spreads each time more and more, both collectively and individually, upon each person. Therefore the Torah warned us (Devarim 25): "Remember what Amalek did to you" — for one must remember well his great war, in order to flee each time to the true Tzadik and his holy Torah. For only he fights the war of Amalek in every generation — the aspect of one "trained in war" — until Mashiach comes speedily in our days, when his seed will be cut off completely, as it is written: "And it shall be, when Hashem your G-d gives you rest in the land… you shall erase the memory of Amalek" etc.

segments.he: אות ג

והתיקון היה על ידי התענית כמו שכתוב צומו עלי וכו'. כי תענית הוא תיקון פגם המאכלים כי על ידי תענית נעשה שמחה שזה בחינת תענית חלום (כמבואר שם היטב עיין שם) ועל כן נקבע פורים לשמחה ולמשתה וליום טוב. כי עיקר התיקון על ידי בחינת שמחה שהוא תיקון המאכלים בחינת חיזוק כח המלאך כנ"ל. וזה בחינת סעודת פורים כי צריכין דייקא להרבות בסעודה בפורים מאחר שזכו לתקן המאכלים. על כן הוא מצוה גדולה אז לשמוח ולהרבות בסעודה לקיים לך אכול בשמחה לחמץך שזהו בחינת תיקון השינה תיקון פגם טומאה הנ"ל (כמו שכתוב שם עיין שם). וזה שאמרו רז"ל משנכנס אדר מרבין בשמחה. כי עיקר התיקון הוא השמחה שהוא חיזוק המלאך כנ"ל. וזהו שדקדקו משנכנס אדר וכו' כי באמת עיקר השמחה היתה ראויה שתתחיל בניסן. כי אז הוא עיק חידוש הרצון ואז הוא זמן השמחה (כמו שכתוב שם). אבל מאחר שחב עלינו המן הרשע להתגבר עלינו באדר על ידי פגם המאכלים כנ"ל על כן אחר שזכינו להתגבר עליו על ידי תיקון השמחה כנל על כן עתה אנו מתחילין השמחה מאדר וזהו משנכנס אדר מרבין בשמחה היינו כי כשנכנס אדר אזי אנו מתחילין בשמחה שהוא חיזוק המלאך כדי להכניע ולשבר כח המן הרשע על ידי זה כנ"ל. כי באמת אף על פי שעיקר חיזוק המלארך הוא בניסן אף על פי כן אנו יכולין לחזק כח המלאך בכל השנה וזה נעשה על ידי השמחה. כי על ידי השמחה נתחזק כח המלאך כאלו נתחדש הרצון אז (כמו שכתוב שם). ועל כן עתה מתחיל השמחה מאדר שהוא חיזוק המלאך כנ"ל. ועל כן עיקר מפלתו היתה בניסן. כי אז הוא עיקר חיזוק המלאך כנ"ל:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the mitzvah of Milah. Through the cutting of the orlah and the spilling of the infant's blood — this is the aspect of cutting off the seed of Amalek. For Amalek is the aspect of the contamination of the orlah, the damage to the Bris. Therefore he contested the mitzvah of Milah — he would cut off circumcisions and hurl them upward, as it is written: "And he cut off the tail — all the weakened ones behind you" — as our Sages said (Tanchuma Ki Seitzei). And the mitzvah of pri'ah, through which the atarah is revealed — this is the aspect of appointing a king. For the revelation of the atarah is the rectification of the Bris, through which one merits malchus, as with Yosef HaTzadik — as the Zohar says: "One who guards the Bris merits kingship." Afterwards the infant is given a name — the aspect of the upper point. For the name of a Jew is included in His Name — "His Name is joined with our name" — drawn from the root of "Yisrael arose in thought first," which is the upper point. Then the Aleph is completed and Adam is formed. For only now is the infant in the aspect of Adam — when the orlah covers the Bris, this is not the form of Adam. Therefore only Yisrael who are circumcised are called Adam. Therefore Milah overrides Shabbos. Though the holiness of Shabbos is exceedingly lofty — even the building of the Beis HaMikdash is pushed aside before it — nevertheless, it is impossible to draw the holiness of Shabbos into this world except through Yisrael specifically, as we say: "You did not give it, Hashem our G-d, to the nations of the lands… for to Yisrael Your people You gave it in love." For Yisrael and Shabbos are one aspect at their root, as understood from Havdalah: "Who distinguishes between holy and mundane, between Yisrael and the nations, between the seventh day and the six days of work." Since the illumination of Shabbos can only be drawn through Yisrael — on the contrary, "a gentile who observes Shabbos is liable to death" — it is an excess of light that causes death. This is what our Sages established in the Shabbos prayer: "Therefore all His creatures shall glorify and bless G-d… who bequeaths rest to His people Yisrael in His holiness on Shabbos Kodesh." For on Shabbos, rest and repose is drawn to all creatures — through which is their entire sustenance. As it is written: "And the heavens and the earth were completed… And Elokim completed on the seventh day His work" — and our Sages expounded: "What was the world lacking? Rest. Shabbos came, rest came." But all this vitality and rest drawn on Shabbos upon all creatures — this is through Yisrael keeping Shabbos. This is (Shemos 31): "And the children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos… between Me and the children of Yisrael it is a sign" — the secret of Shabbos holiness is only between Him and Yisrael, and nothing interposes between them, in the aspect of "and in His joy no stranger shall mingle" (Mishlei 14). Therefore Milah overrides Shabbos — for only through Milah is one formed into Adam, a Jewish man with a share in drawing Shabbos holiness into this world. And this is precisely pikuach nefesh overriding Shabbos — when one of Yisrael is lacking from the world, the drawing of Shabbos holiness is diminished. Therefore Milah and Shabbos are trein sahadin — both depend on each other. It is impossible to draw Shabbos holiness except through Yisrael sealed with the holy seal of Milah; and it is impossible to endure in the holiness of Yisrael except through Shabbos. The essential holiness is the Bris, but few merit this in completeness. The sustenance of most of Yisrael — who have damaged this as they have — is through Milah and Shabbos. Through Milah, all Yisrael are called "Tzadikim" (as Rabeinu z"l wrote in the Torah "Tzivisa Tzedek," siman 23). Through Shabbos, one merits teshuvah. On weekdays, the two witnesses are Tefillin and Milah — for on weekdays, Shabbos holiness is drawn through binding the Tefillin. But on Shabbos itself, Tefillin are forbidden — for through Shabbos holiness itself one is included and bound to Him. Due to the immense stature of Shabbos holiness, even the mitzvah of Shofar on Rosh HaShanah is pushed aside on account of Shabbos shvus — when Rosh HaShanah falls on Shabbos, we do not blow the Shofar, lest one carry it four amos in the public domain (Rosh HaShanah 29b). For on Shabbos it is forbidden to carry from the public domain to the private domain or vice versa. The Tanna began Maseches Shabbos with hotza'ah specifically — "because it was dear to him, he placed it first." This is: "The goings-out of Shabbos are two that are four inside, and two that are four outside. How so? The poor man stands outside and the householder inside." Inside and outside — the aspect of ayeil and nafik. Within each there is ratzo va'shov. The poor man and householder are the Rav and talmid — Moshe and Yehoshua, the upper and lower points. Within the householder (Tzadik/Moshe) himself, there is ayeil and nafik — inner avodos (Torah and prayer) and outer avodos (eating, speaking with people) — each with ratzo va'shov. And the nafik of the Tzadik is far higher than the ayeil of the rest of the world. Likewise among ordinary people, each has ayeil (Torah and prayer) and nafik (commerce, eating), each requiring ratzo va'shov — not to enter or exit beyond the boundary. Therefore: two that are four inside, two that are four outside. All the thirty-nine melachos of the weekdays are berurim — refining holiness from outside to inside. The essential holiness is inside, in the aspect of ayeil; but one must be expert in nafik as well, for this is why a person comes to this world — for the test and the choice. One is compelled to go outside to attend to bodily needs, where the essential test lies. One must be expert there, withstand the test, refine what needs refining, and bring it from outside to inside. This is the service of every person in this world. Therefore the Tanna placed hotza'ah first — all melachos are included in the prohibition of carrying from domain to domain. All melachos are berurim from the public domain to "the domain of the Singular One of the world," as the Zohar says. On Shabbos, carrying is forbidden — for on Shabbos there is no birur. Shabbos holiness is the aspect of "Wait!" — the essential assistance of "one who comes to purify — he is assisted: they say to him, Wait!" All transgressions come from not waiting. Adam HaRishon sinned because he did not wait (Beraishis Rabbah 21:7) — "Who will uncover the dust from your eyes, Adam HaRishon" etc. The essential damage is through haste — "and one who rushes with his feet sins" (Mishlei 19). All this stems from the damage to the expertise — not waiting and settling one's mind properly. From this comes "he peered and was stricken," "he peered and died" — the damage of the great Tzadikim who damaged the expertise of ratzo va'shov, of ayeil and nafik — until there are those in the aspect of Acher who "cut the saplings," Rachmana litzlan. Only Rabbi Akiva entered in peace and exited in peace — expert in ayeil and nafik. When Shabbos arrives, it is forbidden to carry in or out — for then there is no birur, but the aspect of "Wait!" — rest and repose upon all the berurim. Every person must rest and not leave his place: "Let every man remain in his place; let no man go out from his place" (Shemos 16). One must draw upon oneself the holiness of Shabbos — "repose of tranquility and quietude" — to draw settling of mind, the expertise, the "Wait!" — the essential ways of teshuvah rectified on Shabbos. On Rosh HaShanah is the essential teshuvah, for it is the first of the Ten Days of Teshuvah. For then Adam HaRishon was created and called Adam — in order that he merit being included in the aspect of Adam mentioned above. He damaged this through his sin, and the rectification is through teshuvah — which one must engage in every year from Rosh HaShanah until Shemini Atzeres, all to rectify the aspect of Adam. The essential teshuvah is through the blowing of the Shofar, as it is written: "Awake, you sleepers, from your slumber" etc. Therefore they blow TaRaT — a tekiah at the beginning and a tekiah at the end, the aspect of the upper point and the lower point — and a teru'ah in the middle (or teru'ah and shevarim out of doubt), in which are the changes of voices of groaning and wailing. This is the aspect of the Vav — the aspect of changes of colors, that one's face changes to many colors through the shame and spilling of blood, which is the essential teshuvah, as is written there. Therefore Rosh HaShanah is on Rosh Chodesh — for then is the essential rectification of the moon, the aspect of Yehoshua, rectified through teshuvah — whereby the sun illuminates the moon, Moshe illuminates Yehoshua, as mentioned above. Therefore, when Rosh HaShanah falls on Shabbos we do not blow the Shofar — lest one carry it four amos in the public domain. For all teshuvah is through Shabbos, and the main thing is through the aspect of "Wait!" — "Let no man go out from his place on the day of Shabbos" — not to go outside one's four amos. For the four amos each person has in the public domain are like a private domain for him; when one carries out from them, this is carrying from the private domain to the public domain — the essential prohibition of melachah on Shabbos, the essential damage to teshuvah, the damage to the expertise of ayeil and nafik. Therefore, on account of this decree — lest one carry the Shofar from domain to domain — they prohibited blowing the Shofar on Shabbos entirely, outside the Mikdash. For outside the Mikdash one must be very careful not to damage the expertise. Especially now, in the time of the churban and the length of the exile, both collectively and individually — one must wait a great deal, as it is written (Chavakuk 2): "If He delays, wait for Him." And (Yeshayahu 6): "Therefore Hashem will wait to be gracious to you." And (Tzefaniah 3): "Therefore wait for Me, until the day I arise." And likewise every individual — regarding the bitter exile of his soul, having strayed through his sins, his soul greatly distressed, desiring and yearning to return to Hashem, yet it has not been achieved — he must be very careful never to despair in any way, as has been explained countless times. For one must wait a great deal. And all this is drawn through the holiness of Shabbos, through which is the essential rectification of teshuvah. Therefore, on account of the concern lest one carry — which is the damage to Shabbos, the damage to the expertise of ayeil and nafik, the damage to the aspect of "Wait!" — they overrode the Shofar on Shabbos. The essential concern is that due to the preoccupation with the mitzvah of blowing the Shofar, one will go to a sage etc. and thereby carry four amos — specifically from the concern of haste and urgency. For every Jew is in a great rush to return to Hashem. But one who truly wishes to return in teshuvah, though he must urge himself and run with all his might to the true Tzadikim — nevertheless, he must wait. Therefore they were concerned that through the preoccupation with the mitzvah of Shofar — which is itself teshuvah — one might damage the holiness of Shabbos, which is the essential teshuvah. So they overrode the Shofar and relied on the holiness of Shabbos itself — that through Shabbos holiness alone, the ways of teshuvah will be rectified on Rosh HaShanah.

וזה שאמרו רז"ל מה ראתה אסתר שזימנה את המן על הסעודה. לקים את רעב שונאך האכילהו לחם וכו' כי גחלים אתה חותה על ראשו. גחלים דייקא. כי התגברות המן היה על ידי פגם המאכלים כנ"ל. ועיקר ההתגברות ח"ו הוא כי כשאין חיזוק בהמלאך אזי השדים מקבלים ויונקים הרבה מן המאכלים ואזי נתערב כח הש"ד בתוך המאכלים. ומאחר שהשדים מקבלים כח המלאך ח"ו והמלאים הם בחינתמ ראיהו כלפידים כגחלי אש. על כן כשהם מקבליםח"ו כח המלאך עזי מחממים ח"ו בטמאה הנ"ל על ידי זה. וזה היתה כוונת אסתר שזימנה אותו על הסעודה כדי שהי התתן לו לחם לאכול. הי תתןלו דייקא. כי זהו תיקון המאכלים כשאנו נותנין להם לחם לאכול. כי כשאין חיזוק בהמלאך אזי הם יונקים הרבה מן השפע ואנו ניזונים מן התמצית ח"ו. מאחר שהשדים מקבלים הרבה מן הפרנסה ונתערב בהמאכלים כח הש"ד. ועל כן נמשך הפרנסה להעובדי כוכבים ח"ו בשופי. אבל כשי שחיזוק בהמלאך שאז אין השדיםמקבלים מן הפרנסה כי אם כדי חיונו בצמצום אזי כל השפע לנו. וזי הם ניזונים מן התמצית. ואזי אנו נותנין להם פרנסה וזהו תיקון גדול כשאנו מחלקין להם פרנסה. כי באמת כדי חיונו בצמצום צריכין ליתן להם כמובא. נמצא כשאנו נותנין ומחלקין להם פרנסה זהו בחינת תיקון המאכלים. ובשביל זה זימנה אסתר את המן לקים מה שנאמר אם רעב שונאך וכו'. כי באמת צריכין ליתן להם כדי חייהם בצמצום. אבל זהו תיקון גדול מאחר שאנו נותנין להם. וזהו כ גחלם אתה חותה על ראשו. כי עכשיו נתהפך כי כשהם מקבלים לעצמם ויוקנם הרבה. מן השפע ח"ו דהיינו כשאין חיזוק בהמלאך. אזי הם מקבלים כח המלאך שהוא בחינת גחלי אשומתגברים על ידי זה ח"ו. ועל כן עתה שזכו לתיקון המאכלים על ידי התענית כנ"ל ועל כן אז זימנה אסתר את המן להורות שאין לו עוד כח לינק מן השפע רק היא צריכה ליתן לו כנ"ל. וזה ידוע כי כשנמשך להם שפע מן הקדושה בכוונה הוא כדי להכניעם ולהשפילם ועל כן עכשיו כשאסתר מחלקת השפע להמן שהוא הסטרא אחרא אז בודאי גחלים הוא חותה על ראשו. גחלים דייקא. היינו גחלי אש הנ"ל בחינת כח המלאכים אשר מראיהו כגחלי אש. כי עכשיו כשמקבלין כח המלאך בצמצום כדי חיונו כנ"ל זי הוא הכנעתם ואזי הגחלים של המלאכים מלהטת אותם ומבערת אותם כי מהאש יצאו והאש תאכלם. כי זה כלל כי הם מקבלים הרבה מן השפע אזי הם מתגברים ח"ו. ואזי הם מקבלים כח המלאך שהוא בחינת גחלי אש וכו' כנ"ל אבל כשאין יכולין לקבל הרבה רק מה שנותנין להם בצמצום כדי חיונו שזהו בחינת הכנעתם. אזי אדרבא הגחלים של המלאכים נופלים על ראשיהם ושורפים ומכלים אותם. וזהו בחינת כי גחלים אתה חותה על ראשו גחלים דייקא כנ"ל:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the five remembrances one must recall in the blessing of Ahavas Olam and in Krias Shema — which is the emunah of the Unity, as our Sages said. One must remember the deed of Amalek, as it is written (Devarim 25): "Remember what Amalek did to you on the way, when you went out from Mitzrayim" — the aspect of cutting off the seed of Amalek, corresponding to the lower point — "Be still before Hashem" — subduing the blood in the chalal has'mali. For now all the wars fought against Amalek are only through remembrance, which is the essential mitzvah. Therefore we read Parshas Zachor in the Torah — a positive commandment from the Torah. And likewise one must remember every day, especially before accepting the yoke of Heaven in Krias Shema — to focus the thought that the kelipah of Amalek constantly ambushes every Jew without limit. It is impossible to completely uproot him — lest free will be annulled — only in the end of ends his memory will be erased. For now, one must remember and believe in this, so that our eyes always look to Hashem to save us — to fulfill "Be still before Hashem" and bear the spilling of blood etc. All this through the power of the holiness of Shabbos, the aspect of the holiness of the Tzadik — which one must remember always, in the aspect of "Remember the day of Shabbos" — "remember it from the first day of the week" etc. (See below.) And this is the aspect of the remembrance of the deed of Miriam — not to speak lashon hara. For lashon hara is equivalent to the three transgressions — avodah zarah, giluy arayos, and shefichas damim — corresponding to the three points, and it is the greatest of them all. For through lashon hara one separates the Aluf — "a gossip separates" etc. — separating Klal Yisrael (the lower point) from the Tzadik (the upper point). The essential lashon hara is when one speaks against the Tzadik and those attached to him. And even when one speaks against any individual Jew — according to the lashon hara, so is accusation aroused, chas v'shalom, against him, to separate him from the point etc. Therefore the essential rectification is shalom — for this one must make oneself like a wilderness, bear the spilling of blood, and be among "those who hear their disgrace and do not respond" — until they return to us etc. And this is the aspect of the remembrance of the Exodus from Mitzrayim. For the Exodus and the downfall of Amalek are one aspect — subduing the enemies and pursuers of Yisrael, who are the aspect of the evil blood in the chalal has'mali, from which is the hold of all the seventy nations. And Yisrael were chosen from every people and tongue — primarily through the holiness of our forefathers, the seven shepherds, and primarily Moshe Rabeinu — who sanctified themselves so greatly that they completely subdued the blood in the chalal has'mali and all the desires and evil traits drawn from it. They drew the holiness to their offspring until all Yisrael are holy vis-à-vis the seventy nations — through receiving the Torah, which is preserved for us to sanctify ourselves in eating and drinking and in matters of marriage according to the Torah. Through this they subdue the blood in the chalal has'mali, through which we went out from Mitzrayim with miracles and wonders — because they had already been somewhat sanctified, through the merit of the forefathers and the merit of the Torah they would receive. We must remember the Exodus daily — to strengthen our emunah and look forward to salvation always. Just as He took us out of Mitzrayim with such awesome signs and wonders, so may we merit to subdue all enemies. The main one is Amalek who includes them all — "Amalek is the first of the nations" (Bamidbar 24). One must remember well that they have already uprooted him many times — in the days of Moshe and Yehoshua and David and Mordechai — but he is such a strong kelipah that Hashem Himself fights him until the generation of Mashiach, as it is written: "A war for Hashem with Amalek from generation to generation." All this because the power of free will has great force, and He does not wish to annul free will. Every Jew is obligated to fight him — the battle of the yetzer in this world, the essential battle with the turbidity of the bloods from the chalal has'mali. But most people are of weak strength. Therefore all our strength is through the great Tzadikim in every generation who fight on our behalf, as is written in the Torah "T'las nafkin mei'chad" (siman 58). They make known to us and draw to us the holiness of Shabbos Kodesh — through which every Jew has the power to remain standing and not fall completely into the portion of the kelipah of Amalek, who ambushes to uproot a person entirely from both worlds, chas v'shalom. All of Amalek's war is in many aspects — he descends and entices, intensifying the evil bloods and introducing many evil thoughts into the heart, which are the essential evil inclinations — and he ascends and accuses, and through the accusations his power intensifies further, chas v'shalom. And not content with this, he spreads himself with awesome stratagems to increase machlokes against the true Tzadik who is mighty in strength — until he introduces ti'na even into the hearts of great Tzadikim, to divide their hearts from him by introducing many difficulties against him — until through this many of Yisrael distance themselves from him. And this is the worst of all. Through all the above, you will understand on your own all the five remembrances one must recall in Krias Shema and its blessings. The remembrance of the deed of Amalek — the essential totality of the kelipos that wishes to distance from Hashem, even introducing heresies into the heart, Rachmana litzlan. Therefore one must remember this well. For now we have no power to fight him physically — only to remember well the deed of Amalek, so we understand that all the evil thoughts and evil desires are all the deeds of Amalek. But we have the power to subdue him — even those who consider themselves very weak — only one must remember the day of Shabbos, the aspect of the power of the true Tzadik. And likewise one must remember Matan Torah, the aspect of Shabbos on which the Torah was given — for through the holy Torah that Moshe drew for us, and through the chidushei Torah of the true Tzadikim in every generation, they subdue him. And most of all, one must remember the Exodus from Mitzrayim — a positive commandment to remember every day aloud — to remember and take to heart that Hashem has already helped us greatly, and we have already gone out from many very powerful kelipos — the aspect of the Exodus from Mitzrayim. Through this our hope and strength will be fortified to prevail against him with the power of the Tzadik — until it will be fulfilled: "As in the days of your going out from Mitzrayim, I will show him wonders." For this reason we mention the Exodus extensively in the prayer, in Emes V'yatziv etc. But one must also remember the deed of Miriam — to be careful of lashon hara. For the greatest damage is through lashon hara — through which one distances, chas v'shalom, from the true Tzadik, the aspect of Moshe, through whom comes all the strengthening in this long war. As is written in all the mussar books — all the physical wars between kings are called a "small war" compared to the war a person has with himself, which is called a "long war." This is the essential war of Amalek in every generation — collectively and individually, with every person, at every time. And most of Yisrael have no power to stand in his war except through the power of the Tzadik. Through lashon hara one is separated from him — therefore he is called a "gossip who separates the chief [aluf]." Therefore they warned us to remember the deed of Miriam — to teach that even though they were awesome Tzadikim, nevertheless Aharon and Miriam erred in this, that they questioned Moshe. All the more so that it is forbidden for the rest of the people to question, chas v'shalom, the true Tzadik — even if one hears from other Tzadikim some difficulty against him, all the more so etc. Therefore Rosh HaShanah is called Yom HaZikaron [the Day of Remembrance]. For then is the first of the Ten Days of Teshuvah, and the essential teshuvah is through remembrance — remembering Hashem and the World to Come, prevailing over whatever each person must prevail over. This is the aspect of remembering Shabbos, which is the aspect of the World to Come — through which one subdues the aspect of Amalek etc. Likewise all the remembrances are included in Rosh HaShanah, which is the first of the Ten Days of Teshuvah, comprised of all of them. For in it is the aspect of the beginning of teshuvah, which is very difficult, as our Sages said (Mechilta, Parshas Yisro): "All beginnings are difficult." Therefore Rosh HaShanah is called Yom HaZikaron. For Amalek is the totality of the kelipos, the totality of the exile of the seventy nations, who wish to cause His Name to be forgotten from the world, chas v'shalom, as it is written (see Yirmiyahu 23): "who plan to make [the people] forget Your Name." Therefore they devise plans against Yisrael, as it is written (Tehillim 83): "Against Your people they conspire cunningly… so that the name of Yisrael will no longer be remembered. They have conspired with one heart against You; they cut a covenant" etc. Therefore one must remember the deed of Amalek — to know that all manner of evil thoughts, whether of fantasies and desires, or of difficulties and heresies — all are the aspect of Amalek. And one must remember that the ancient Tzadikim already uprooted him, yet he still intensifies and spreads. But Hashem will uproot him completely — "A war for Hashem with Amalek from generation to generation" — in every generation Hashem sends great Tzadikim who draw the magnification of His Name and His remembrance in the world, in the aspect of "This is My Name forever, and this is My remembrance from generation to generation" (Shemos 3). For through the erasure of Amalek from generation to generation, His remembrance is maintained from generation to generation. And this is (Pesachim 50): "'This is My Name' and 'this is My remembrance'… Not as I am written am I read" etc. — this is the aspect of the upper point and the lower point. For the Name Havayah — the aspect of "This is My Name forever" — is the upper point, the aspect of "the glory of G-d is to conceal a matter." And the Name Adnus — the aspect of "this is My remembrance" — is the lower point, the aspect of the revelation of His malchus. When these two Names are included and unified together — the lower point and the upper point — through this the aspect of Adam is formed. And this is the aspect of the five remembrances mentioned above: the remembrance of the deed of Amalek and the Exodus from Mitzrayim — the aspect of the lower point. Shabbos — the aspect of the upper point, comprised of all of them, the aspect of Moshe etc. The remembrance of Matan Torah — the aspect of the Vav within the Aleph, for the essential binding and drawing of vitality from the upper point to the lower point is through the Torah, which is the amuda d'emtza'isa [middle pillar]. And one must also remember the deed of Miriam — to be very careful of lashon hara and machlokes, which is the opposite of all this and ruins everything, chas v'shalom — for it is the aspect of "a gossip separates the chief [aluf]," as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of Pashta Munach Zarka Segol. Zarka — the aspect of the lower point, the essential teshuvah to return it to its place, to the aspect of the upper point, in the aspect of "Zarka d'izdrikas la'asar d'isnat'lis misaman" [the zarka that was thrown to the place from which it was taken], as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of Segol, which is the upper point, as is written in the aforementioned Torah. And Pashta — this is the aspect of the Vav within the Aleph, through which they are bound and included together, as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of Munach — the aspect of Shabbos, which is repose and rest. For the essential binding and inclusion is through Shabbos, which is a day of rest, as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of Krias HaTorah on Shabbos. For the essential fulfillment of the Torah is through Shabbos. For the fulfillment of the Torah is very difficult to draw into the world — "for the inclination of man's heart is evil from his youth" — and the ba'al davar [Adversary] incites every person greatly to sin, chas v'shalom. Therefore many have stumbled as they have stumbled — Hashem have mercy from now on. For this reason the angels protested greatly about the creation of man, saying "What is man…?" — "he is destined to sin before You" etc. And likewise at Matan Torah they protested the giving of the Torah to Yisrael (Shabbos 88b) — all because they saw that many would transgress the Torah and few would merit fulfilling it completely. But Hashem did not listen to them and said: "For nothing was I called merciful and gracious?" — for He saw that there would be Tzadikim in every generation who would fulfill the Torah in completeness, and they would return Yisrael in teshuvah until in the end the complete redemption will come through Mashiach Tzidkeinu. Therefore He created man and gave the Torah to Yisrael. It emerges that the essential Matan Torah was through teshuvah that preceded the world — Hashem preceded the remedy to the affliction, which is teshuvah. Even if Yisrael sin, He has already prepared for them the remedy of teshuvah. But the essential way of teshuvah is drawn through the holiness of Shabbos, which the true Tzadikim draw, as mentioned above. Therefore we read the Torah on Shabbos more than any other time of the year — reading all seven aliyos and completing the entire Torah from sidra to sidra each Shabbos until completing it on Simchas Torah. This shows that the essential drawing of the Torah into the world — that we merit to fulfill it, which is the main thing — is through Shabbos, the aspect of teshuvah, through which the essential fulfillment of the Torah comes. Therefore we read seven aliyos on Shabbos, corresponding to the seven shepherds from Avraham to David — whose essential one is Moshe, who gave us the Torah. For all the seven shepherds drew the Torah. The beginning was from Avraham, as our Sages said (Yoma 28b): "Avraham fulfilled the entire Torah" etc. — and from him to Yitzchak and Yaakov etc., until it was given through Moshe Rabeinu. But the essential place of the Torah is in Eretz Yisrael and the Beis HaMikdash, as it is written (Yeshayahu 2): "For from Tziyon shall go forth Torah." Therefore the completion of the fulfillment of the Torah is through David, the seventh of the seven shepherds — for he labored and found the place of the Beis HaMikdash and engaged in its building, and it is named after him: "Beis David." Therefore we read seven aliyos on Shabbos, the aspect of the seven shepherds — for the essential fulfillment of the Torah drawn through the seven shepherds is through Shabbos, the aspect of teshuvah. And this is the aspect of the reading of the Maftir in the Nevi'im. For all the Nevi'im are in the aspect of talmidim of Moshe Rabeinu, who is the master of all the Nevi'im. Therefore they are all included in Yehoshua — the first book of the Nevi'im — for he was the first talmid-prophet of Moshe, "who did not depart from the Tent." All the Nevi'im received through him, as they said (Avos 1): "Moshe received Torah from Sinai and transmitted it to Yehoshua, and Yehoshua to the Elders, and the Elders to the Nevi'im" etc. Yehoshua is the aspect of the lower point, receiving from the upper point which is Moshe — through whom specifically Moshe illuminates the Torah to Yisrael. Therefore all the seven shepherds — whose essential one is Moshe, through whom the Torah is drawn — all their illumination of the Torah to Yisrael is through the aspect of Yehoshua, the lower point, the aspect of the chirik of S"G, the aspect of "and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You" — as is explained in the aforementioned Torah. For the essential thing is to cut off the seed of Amalek, from whom comes the seething of the bloods in the chalal has'mali, from which come all sins and damages, Rachmana litzlan. This war is waged by Moshe — the true Rav of the generation — through the aspect of Yehoshua the talmid. For specifically Yehoshua pertains to this, as it is written: "Go out and fight with Amalek." Through this specifically, the upper point illuminates the lower point and the way of teshuvah is drawn into the world. Therefore we read the Nevi'im for Maftir, for all the Nevi'im are in the aspect of Yehoshua — and we read them after Krias HaTorah, for the essential fulfillment of the Torah is through the aspect of Yehoshua the talmid, the lower point, through whom the Tzadik (the aspect of Moshe) draws the way of teshuvah into the world — through the holiness of Shabbos. Therefore we mention in the blessings of the Haftarah the sprouting of the horn of Mashiach — that in the end Hashem will finish and all Yisrael will merit fulfilling the Torah through Mashiach Tzidkeinu, as is stated in those blessings: "Faithful are You, Hashem our G-d, and not a single word of Your words shall return empty… for in Your holy Name You swore to him that his light shall never be extinguished" etc. For the essential fulfillment of the Torah — which is the sprouting of the horn of Mashiach — is through the aspect of the Nevi'im, the aspect of Yehoshua, the lower point, through which the Tzadik (the aspect of Moshe) draws the way of teshuvah into the world. And this is what our Sages said — that they instituted reading the Nevi'im for Maftir because once the wicked kingdom decreed that the Torah should not be read, and they read from the Nevi'im instead; afterwards, when the decree was annulled, they retained the practice of reading the Nevi'im for all generations. That is: even when the wicked kingdom wishes to nullify the Torah from Yisrael through their great provocations — nevertheless, the Torah is sustained through the Nevi'im. Therefore they did not abolish this practice of reading the Nevi'im after Krias HaTorah — to show and make known that the essential fulfillment of the Torah is through the Nevi'im, the aspect of Yehoshua, the aspect of the talmidim of the true Tzadikim, through whom the essential drawing of the way of teshuvah comes — through which the Torah is fulfilled, as mentioned above.

וזה בחינת ומשלוח מנות איש לרעהו, מנות דייקא בחינ מן כי המן היה יורד משחקם שם שוחקין מן ושחקים הוא מדור המלאכים והוא בחינת חיזוק המלאך בחינת שחוק ושמחה (כמבואר במאמר הנ"ל עיין שם) ועל כן המן היורד משם היה מאכל קדוש מאד כי לא היה להסטרא אחראט שום אחיזה בו כי היה יורד משחקים שהוא חיזוק המלאך כנ"ל. ועל כן היה המן כמונח בקופסא להורות שאין להסטרא אחרא שום אחיזה בו. כי המן היה בלי מוץ ותבן כי לא היה להסטר אאחרא שום אחיזה בו. כי המן היה בלי מוץ ותבן כי לא היה להסטרא אחרא שום אחיזה בו. וזה בחינת שמלוח מנות בפורים. להורות כי עכשיו הוא תיקון המאכלים. ועל כן עתה השפע נשלמת מאחד לחבירו בשפע גדול. כי עכשו אין לנו שום פחד כלל מהסטרא אחרא כין אין להסטרא אחרא שום אחיה בהמאכלים עכשיו. כי עכשיו הוא חיזוק המלאך על ידי השמחה של פורים כנ"ל ועל כן נקרא משלו מנות בחינת מן היורד משחקים שם השחוק והשמחה שהוא חיזוק המלאך כנ"ל וזה שנוהגין לכסות במפה כששולחין משלוח מנות. זה רמז על המן שהיה כמונח בקופסא וכמו שכתב בשולחן ערוך שבשביל זה מכסין במפה לחם של שבת זכר למן וכו'. כי גם משלוח מנות הוא בחינת מן שהיה כמונח בקופסא. כי אין להסטרא אחרא שום אחיזה במאכלים של פורים כי אז הוא חיזוק המלאך כנ"ל:
segments.en: Therefore before Rosh HaShanah, Yom Kippur, and the Ten Days of Teshuvah is the month of Elul, in which Yisrael are aroused in teshuvah. For then they are engaged — through the power of the Tzadikim — in making the road for teshuvah, which is the aspect of "Who makes a way in the sea and a path in mighty waters" (Yeshayahu 43) — which is the secret of the kavanos of Elul, as mentioned above. Its essential aspect is the expertise in halachah mentioned above — the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven, there You are; and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You" etc. For through this one merits Rosh HaShanah, Yom Kippur, and the Ten Days of Teshuvah, in which is the essential teshuvah. For it is impossible to merit teshuvah except through this path — when one accepts upon himself that however things may be, he will strengthen himself in Hashem always, in the aspect of "and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You" — then specifically he will merit teshuvah. For there are many ascents and descents that every person must pass through, which cannot be explained in writing. Especially one who has already stumbled as he has stumbled — therefore, if he wishes to have compassion on his life and better his end, he must go on his hands and knees to receive this path of the expertise in halachah mentioned above. And then he will merit a good end forever. And now — how beautiful and how pleasant is the order that our Sages established for us: "everything beautiful in its time" (Koheles 3)! For immediately on Simchas Torah, when we conclude the Torah with the passing of Moshe — "and Yehoshua was full of the spirit of wisdom" etc. (as above, section 25) — we begin Beraishis and read until the parshah of the holiness of Shabbos, which is Vayechulu, as mentioned above. For the essential avodah from Elul until now is to draw the way of teshuvah into the world — primarily through Shabbos, which the Tzadikim — the aspect of Moshe who illuminates and makes known through the aspect of Yehoshua — make known to us. Therefore we immediately read the Haftarah from the beginning of the Book of Yehoshua, which speaks of the passing of Moshe and Yehoshua's need to strengthen himself, as it is written there (Yehoshua 1): "Moshe My servant has died — now arise, cross over" etc., and they conclude with: "Only be strong and courageous." For this is the essential rectification and hope — that Moshe drew such a rectification that even after his passing he continues to draw the way of teshuvah into the world through the aspect of Yehoshua, through which they conquer Eretz Yisrael etc. And this we read every single year. For "His dominion is in every generation" — each year this aspect is accomplished anew, beginning the Torah from sidra to sidra each Shabbos until completing it at the conclusion of the seal within the seal of Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur, which is on Shemini Atzeres and Simchas Torah. And it is all in order to illuminate and draw the holiness of Shabbos, which is the way of teshuvah in the world. For I heard from his holy mouth, zichrono livrachah, after he said the aforementioned Torah, that wherever there is a true Rav and a talmid who learns from him, there is formed this aspect of Moshe and Yehoshua and the Ohel Mo'ed — through which the essential drawing of the way of teshuvah into the world comes about. And in this they are engaged from Elul until Shemini Atzeres, and then they read the Haftarah from Yehoshua — which is the first Haftarah, for all the Haftaros from the Nevi'im are in the aspect of Yehoshua, the first book of the Nevi'im. For Yehoshua is the lower point, through whom the aspect of Moshe illuminates in every generation, every year, the way of teshuvah into the world, as mentioned above. It has been explained throughout all the above that the essential rectification is Shabbos — which is a "good gift" etc. And the main thing: through Shabbos everyone will merit teshuvah, through which the redemption will come. Therefore one must be very careful to honor Shabbos and remember it always. For Shabbos is the tachlis — the aspect of "the purpose of heaven and earth" etc. This is why they conclude the Haftarah of Yom Kippur — which speaks of teshuvah — with the keeping of Shabbos, as it is written there (Yeshayahu 58): "If you restrain your foot because of Shabbos… then you shall delight upon Hashem" etc. For the essential teshuvah is on Yom Kippur, and even Yom Kippur receives from Shabbos. For Shabbos is the "head of all the sacred times," as we say, "and You blessed it above all the times" — for all the teshuvah rectification of Yom Kippur is through Shabbos. Therefore they conclude the Haftarah of Yom Kippur with the keeping of Shabbos. Through this you will see wonders in the Torah — how everything is arranged in a wondrous order. For this reason Moshe Rabeinu placed the parshah of keeping Shabbos before the parshah of the sin of the Golden Calf, as is evident in Parshas Ki Sisa — which speaks of the Mishkan, then: "But My Shabbasos you shall keep… and the children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos… an eternal covenant between Me and the children of Yisrael" — and immediately afterward begins speaking of the sin of the Calf. This is to reveal and make known the kindnesses of Hashem and His wonders: that in His wondrous kindness He always precedes the remedy to the affliction, as our Sages said (Megillah 13b). Before this evil and bitter deed of the sin of the Golden Calf — through which they caused damage for all generations and brought about all the churbanos, for they drew the yetzer hara back upon themselves, from which all the damages come even now — He preceded and made known to us in His Torah the holiness of Shabbos Kodesh, placing it first, to show that He has already preceded the rectification and the remedy, which is the holiness of Shabbos that we receive from the true Tzadikim, the aspect of Moshe. Through this everything will be rectified, for through this the way of teshuvah is drawn into the world. Therefore the thousand lights that were withdrawn through the sin of the Golden Calf are returned to Moshe on Shabbos, and Moshe returns them to Yisrael, as is written in the kavanos — for the essential rectification of the sin of the Golden Calf is through Shabbos. Therefore at the entrance of Shabbos we say Mizmor Shir L'Yom HaShabbos — the psalm that Adam HaRishon said at the entrance of Shabbos, close to his sin, as our Sages said — for "Shabbos protected him." And this is the aspect of what is written in the tale of the Two Children Who Were Exchanged — that when one is pursued from Gan Eden, one must station oneself by Shabbos, as is written there, and as brought above. Therefore he said there (Tehillim 92): "How great are Your works, Hashem; exceedingly deep are Your thoughts. A boorish man does not know… But You are exalted forever, Hashem." Rashi explains: "Forever Your hand is on high." That is — he saw immediately that even though the Samech-Mem and his forces provoked so much that they caused him to sin on the very first day — from which would result everything that would result — nevertheless, in His mercy Hashem rested Ruach HaKodesh upon him, and he immediately said Mizmor Shir L'Yom HaShabbos and concluded: "But You are exalted forever, Hashem" — for forever Your hand is on high. For through the power of Shabbos holiness, His G-dliness will be revealed always — through the Tzadikim — even in ikvesa d'Meshicha, even in these last generations where the concealment within the concealment has intensified without end. Nevertheless, the way of teshuvah will continue to be drawn into the world — the aspect of "If I ascend to heaven… and if I make my bed in She'ol, behold You" — through the holiness of Shabbos. And this is also what we say afterward in the psalm "Hashem has reigned, He has donned grandeur" etc. (Tehillim 93): "More than the voices of many waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea — mighty on high is Hashem." For even though the many waters and mighty breakers of the sea overwhelm every person so greatly — in the aspect of "all Your breakers and waves have passed over me" (Tehillim 42) — nevertheless, mightier than all of them is Hashem on high. He will finish everything according to His will and bring everything to the true, eternal, good end — for He has already preceded and given Yisrael the holiness of Shabbos. Therefore we say this at the entrance of Shabbos. Therefore, even one who has sinned greatly, chas v'shalom — as long as he is not a mumar to anger [Hashem] or to desecrate Shabbos, he is included in Klal Yisrael etc. But a mumar to desecrate Shabbos is like a mumar to the entire Torah and leaves the category of Yisrael. For the essential sustaining of the holiness of Yisrael is through Shabbos, as mentioned above. Therefore, in everything that passes over a person, one must remember Shabbos always. Especially regarding parnasah — for one must sanctify all the activities and commerce, which are included in the thirty-nine melachos, with the holiness of Shabbos, as Rabeinu z"l wrote (siman 38). For one must remember that the essential blessing of parnasah is from Shabbos — "from which all six days are blessed." And likewise when thoughts pursue a person greatly — one must station oneself by Shabbos, which is rest and repose. For the essential rectification of thought is to be "sit and do not act" — even in thought, as is written elsewhere — and to nullify oneself in the holiness of Shabbos and direct one's thought into the Torah that was given on Shabbos, from which all chidushei Torah are drawn. And likewise regarding jealousy, hatred, and machlokes between a person and his fellow or between husband and wife — which is very common and very damaging as is known — one must remind oneself of the holiness of Shabbos, which is shalom, the aspect of "Shabbos Shalom." And in everything that passes over a person each and every day, one must flee in thought to the holiness of Shabbos — all through the power of the Tzadikim who make known to us the holiness of Shabbos.
